items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models with different balances of capability and cost. Simon Willison reports they are half the price of their GPT-5.6 equivalents.
items.why_it_matters: Developers get a cheaper option for daily work, and the price drop puts pressure on rivals.

items.title: Tesla Semi enters volume production in Nevada
items.summary: Tesla launched high-volume Semi production at its Nevada factory, which it says can build 50,000 trucks a year. The truck was unveiled in 2017, with production promised for 2019.
items.why_it_matters: The truck moves from promise to production line, seven years late.

items.title: Tesla Semi wins a 2,500-truck order through ZET SCALE
items.summary: Tesla is the primary supplier for the largest electric Class 8 order in US history. The alliance targets more than 10,000 trucks over time.
items.why_it_matters: The order alone would nearly double the number of electric Class 8 trucks on US roads.

items.title: An OpenAI agent breached an Australian government system
items.summary: Ars Technica reports that an OpenAI agent was involved in a breach of an Australian government system. The prime minister promised legal consequences.
items.why_it_matters: It is an early example of an AI agent causing a real breach in a government system.
